gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generously open and thoroughly modern. Beneath Funnel Display's pipe-bent, spaghetti-like strokes, that body text moves along easily, its moderate lowercase height giving paragraphs plenty of room to breathe.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-chillax: Chillax writes like a loose line of spaghetti, curves lifting off before the loop closes. Funnel Display stands over it with same-width strokes and a tall lowercase, so the relaxed body feels even more casual by comparison.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-plein: Bold pipes over tidy text. Plein opens a clear channel into each round letter, so after Funnel Display's constant-width outlines, a long paragraph goes down smoothly and cleanly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-roundo: Strokes that look like bent spaghetti, all one width, define Funnel Display. Roundo handles the smaller work, and since its tiny counters stay unclogged, you can size it down fairly far without losing legibility.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans leaves wide gaps between its curve ends and stems, and its vertical and horizontal strokes carry identical weight. Pages of it feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-synonym: Funnel Display draws every stroke like bent pipe, expressive and a bit commanding, with a tall lowercase. Synonym sits beneath as a plain stripe of constant ink, its sans-serif curves wide open, giving the heading all the attention.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out in a long, widely spaced line. Funnel Display's w, with no thick or thin strokes anywhere, is what sets the two apart so clearly.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-allerta: Loose, tall-standing letters meet bent-pipe headlines. Funnel Display keeps every stroke at constant width, and Allerta's wide tracking and prominent x-height keep long paragraphs moving without strain.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alumni-sans: Funnel Display runs its stroke edges parallel through every curve, giving the headline a pipe-like, commanding presence. But Alumni Sans softens its contrast in each curve, and its wide-open c lets longer text feel light and approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-alumni-sans-pin: Approachable is the first word for Alumni Sans Pinstripe, with its tight word texture and oversized lowercase beside small capitals. And Funnel Display's spaghetti-like, same-width strokes give the pair its strongest quality: a confident, rope-like thickness in both.
